source_text: Quiescit terra donec quiescit peccatum. Moveri dicitur terra quando peccatum redit. Exsurge Debbora — oratio suscitans populum.
pass_a_gloss: Rests land until rests sin. To-be-moved is-said land when sin returns. Arise Deborah — prayer raising people.
pass_b_english: The land rests while sin rests; the land is stirred when sin returns. [[Arise, Deborah >> Bible:Judges 5:12]] — prayer that raises the people.
notes: True OET; no copyrighted Judges FOTC.
